name: Frank Sinatra
hook: The Hoboken crooner with the blue eyes, the Rat Pack and "My Way."

facts.label: Hoboken, New Jersey
facts.statement: Francis Albert Sinatra was born in Hoboken, New Jersey, in December 1915, the son of a tavern owner.

facts.label: My Way
facts.statement: Paul Anka rewrote the lyrics of the French song "Comme d'Habitude" as "My Way," which became Sinatra's signature song.

facts.label: the Rat Pack
facts.statement: Lauren Bacall coined "the Rat Pack" for the carousing circle that included Humphrey Bogart, Judy Garland and Sinatra.

facts.label: Chairman of the Board
facts.statement: Sinatra was nicknamed the Chairman of the Board after creating and heading his own label, Reprise Records.

facts.label: From Here to Eternity
facts.statement: Sinatra won an Oscar for playing Maggio in the 1953 film From Here to Eternity.

facts.label: New York, New York
facts.statement: Sinatra's "New York, New York" — "if I can make it there, I'll make it anywhere" — is a staple at Yankee Stadium.
associations: If I can make it there

facts.label: Strangers in the Night
facts.statement: "Strangers in the Night" was a 1966 No. 1 in which Sinatra ad-libbed "Scooby Dooby Doo."
